about.title: From *Clicks to Kicks*
about.body: DV Shop Cebu started in 2020 as an online sneaker shop, driven by a love of streetwear culture and a mission to bring authentic pairs to fellow sneakerheads. In 2022 it opened its own physical store in Celadon Town, Lapu-Lapu City: a spot for sneaker lovers to connect, shop and experience the culture in person, with DV Cafe pouring coffee inside.

faqs.a: Every pair is inspected, and DV Shop works directly with trusted suppliers. Legit pairs only.

faqs.q: Can I pay cash on delivery?
faqs.a: Yes, nationwide. Card, e-wallets, BPI, GCash, Maya and SPayLater are accepted too.
DV Shop ships nationwide and worldwide.
Daily, 11am to 8pm, at Unit 14 G/F Bldg 2, Celadon Town, Brgy. Pajac, Lapu-Lapu City.
